alert.title: 775 customer sites unreachable; tenant-router 5xx jumped
alert.description: A scripted deactivation job intended to disable a legacy feature for specific tenants was misconfigured to also delete the tenants' product instances permanently.

expected.notes: Operator script ran a hard-delete path instead of the intended soft-disable, removing tenant data across 775 cloud sites. Backups + multi-day restore process required.
